verdict.rationale: Quo's own features run in the background without a user present. Its Sona AI agent answers calls when the team can't and hands conversations back, recorded calls are transcribed and summarized automatically, and AI call tags, phone menus and custom ring orders route and handle calls without manual steps. There is no evidence of a general automation builder where users define their own triggers, actions or recurring schedules, so only the depth of user-configurable automation is unproven. Missing for 10: user-defined trigger/action workflows, scheduled or recurring automations, webhooks or event triggers for background agents, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Sona answers when your team can't, captures the details you need, and hands the conversation to your team when it matters.
Recorded calls come back transcribed and summarized, so no detail is missed and nobody has to take notes.
Custom ring orders ... Call transfers ... Phone menus
